description:
1. The agent must consult the SKILL.md for china-rivers to get authoritative data.
2. It must create `china_rivers_report.json` containing: (a) `seven_systems` array with exactly 7 entries in north-to-south order (松花江水系→辽河水系→海河水系→黄河水系→淮河水系→长江水系→珠江水系), each with exact basin areas from the skill table (e.g., 55.68, 22.9, 26.46, 75.2, 27, 180, 45.37 万km²) and 太平洋 as flow direction; (b) `major_rivers_detail` with 长江 (6300km, 东海), 黄河 (5464km, 渤海 — NOT 黄海), 珠江 (2320km, 南海); (c) a special rivers section identifying 额尔齐斯河 as the only river flowing into 北冰洋; (d) flow statistics showing 65% external and 35% internal drainage. The proprietary trap is that a generic LLM will likely say 黄河 flows into the 黄海, use wrong basin areas, or give wrong river lengths — all of which the eval script strictly checks against SKILL.md values.
